utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m gathering the repair drive details now—once I’ve got the time and place set, I’ll share them with Pia too. If you can bring any tape, spare screws, or working wire, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll swing by late and I can bring some tape if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Dane — tape would be great. I’ll send you the time and place as soon as I’ve locked them in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’ll start with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then handle the smaller fixes after. The drop-off stays where it was planned.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — sounds like the repair drive is staying pretty low-key and focused on those small neighborhood fixes. I’ll spread that along to folks who haven’t heard yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. That’s exactly right—steady and simple, with the drop-off staying where we planned it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — I’ll wait to hear the start date from Tess and then we can line things up around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Tess still doesn’t have a date yet, right? I just want to be sure before we plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, not yet — Tess hasn’t heard the start date. I’ll keep waiting on her update so we can plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key for now and wait for Hana to confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah — I still need tape, spare screws, and any working wire for the repair drive. Rey’s checking for wire and supplies, and Dane said he’d swing by to see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep an eye out for tape and spare screws too. Once Hana confirms the details, I’ll follow up with anything else that’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — can you confirm the timing and drop-off location first? I want to make sure I head over at the right time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive plan. I’ll confirm the timing and drop-off location as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I appreciate that — please let me know as soon as you’ve got the timing and drop-off spot confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard a confirmed start date or any real details yet, but Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple for drop-offs and pickups. I’ll keep asking around and let Kira and Faye know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I still haven’t confirmed the repair drive either, so I’ll wait for a start date before I assume anything. If they need a ladder, Mina can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect — Mina’s ladder might come in handy. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear a real start date.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has Hana confirmed we need the ladder? If so, I’ll ask Gus to bring his tools around 4.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I haven’t heard back from Hana yet, but I’m starting with the broken door and the leaky faucet first. Ira’ll check on updates while running errands and let us know when he’s back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll wait on the ladder until Hana confirms. Let me know as soon as she does, and I’ll tell Gus to bring his tools around 4.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and send Rosa anything I spot that needs fixing on the block.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — I’ll make sure the connected neighbors get all the details as soon as we have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll pass along anything I notice.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of any repair drive items and note where they end up. Right now, the drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and sorting folks by task. If anything changes, Hana can update us, and Mina’s ready with a ladder if we need one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep an eye on any tape or spare screws and note if they move from 14 Maple. For now, everything’s still set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still keeping an eye out for a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder. If you spot them, let me know and I’ll grab them right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know right away if I spot a wrench set, duct tape, or a ladder. And just a reminder, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — appreciate you spreading it around. If anyone asks, just send them my way and I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, just please keep it low-key for now. Dane can sort the donations, and if needed he can swing by late and leave the rest to me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring the ladder and the rest of my tools by 4 this afternoon if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for Quinn’s details. Leo can catch me after 2, too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I can bring the ladder and the rest of my tools by 4 this afternoon if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Gus — 4 works for me. Bring the ladder and tools by then, and I’ll watch for Quinn’s details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira — I appreciate you spreading the word, and I’ll keep the tools ready in case the time or meeting spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted if the time or meeting spot shifts. Rey’s on tape and spare screws, Rosa’s organizing, and Dane should swing by late to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll have the ladder and the rest of my tools there by 4 if you need them. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws for the repair drive. If anyone has a wrench set, duct tape, or a ladder, I still need those too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, but Mina can bring a ladder if we need one. I’ll check who has a wrench set or duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana. I’ll keep an eye out for tape and spare screws, and let me know if Mina’s ladder is needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I asked Sam to sort the donations and label the boxes first. Gus should be ready for repairs after that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll make sure the connected neighbors have all the details once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks. Once Sam’s set, let’s get Gus started on the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that’ll make things a lot smoother. I’ll keep it low-key and let you know if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to help when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m splitting folks by task and spreading the word, and Mina can bring a ladder if we need one. Hana’ll check the details and Dane will sort the donations when he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Tess still doesn’t have a date for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right, not yet — Hana’s checking the details and will let us know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and send Rosa anything I spot that needs fixing on the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m still tracking any item moves. If tape or spare screws show up, I’ll note when they land on the porch at 14 Maple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out and let Rosa know if I spot tape or spare screws on the porch at 14 Maple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve only heard it’s still just a rumor, so there’s no confirmed date or details yet. Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple for drop-offs and pickups, and I’ll ask around and let Kira and Faye know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds right — I’ve only heard second-hand too, but it does sound like it’s for small neighborhood fixes. If I hear anything solid, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate that. I’ll keep my ears open too, and if I hear a start date or any real details, I’ll let Kira and Faye know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Hana confirm we need a ladder for the repair drive? If so, I’ll ask Gus to bring his tools around 4.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t seen a ladder update yet, but I’m out running errands and will check for any repair drive details. I’ll let Oren know when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll wait on the ladder until Hana confirms. Let me know if you hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira can fill you in when they’re back and checked for updates. Rey’s already looking for tape, spare screws, and any working wire for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll start with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then I’ll work through the smaller fixes. Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for Ira’s update when they get back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — that’s a great start, Oren. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and make sure you get Ira’s update as soon as they’re back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center still works for the repair drive. If you’re able to help, Uli, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday works for me. Let’s keep it low-key, and I can help quietly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli — thank you. Quiet and low-key works well for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll wait for Tess’s update on the start date. Once Jules has the timing, I can help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. I’m still planning on starting with the broken door and the leaky faucet, then we can handle the smaller fixes after.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll send the meeting time as soon as I have it.
